{"consolidated_memory":"COMPONENT: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (mobile sync side)

RECURRING PROBLEM: Conflict loop in the sync engine—two clients rewriting each other on every pass. Reproducible by editing the same note on two devices offline.

COVERING TEST: mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift (Swift stack)

THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS:

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-19] (c014-e1)
- Trigger: Accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: Two writes never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #1797, branch fix/conflict-loop-2)
- Result: Throughput rose 10% to 17 requests per second

INCIDENT 2 [2026-08-27] (c014-e4)
- Trigger: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #6426, branch fix/conflict-loop-5)
- Result: Reclaimed 49 GB of blob storage

INCIDENT 3 [2026-09-01] (c014-e5)
- Trigger: Staging read replica
- Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #6786, branch fix/conflict-loop-6)
- Result: Memory settled at 713 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB"}
